# TinyStart — Voiceover (auto-generated)

Narration is defined in **`narration.json`** and synthesized at build time via macOS `say` (voice: Samantha).

Regenerate video + audio:

```bash
npm run demo:video
```

## Product segment (synced to UI)

1. Intro — empty Home
2. Quick capture — Draft project README
3. Motivation — course assignment
4. Breakdown — three steps
5. Home hero — step 1 of 3
6. Focus — 2 min preset
7. Step advance — done with this step
8. Short timer hold
9. Celebration
10. Micro recap on Home
11. Daily recap + Breakdown tag

## Agentic segment (B-roll over recap)

12. Specification-Driven Development (`requirements.md`, `AGENTS.md`)
13. Scope/tone decisions + OpenSpec capabilities
14. Loop engineering + NFR-DX-01 gate
15. Maker ≠ checker + full agent pipeline

**Total runtime:** ~89 s (under 2:00 course limit)
